QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Situation in Kritias
QuestInfo.0: You reported the situation in Kritias to Neinheart. What's his plan?
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart feels he's missing something after hearing everything that happened in Kritias. He asks you to investigate Kritias again to shed light on the questions that still remain. The first person to meet is Head Maid Parma.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart feels he's missing something after hearing everything that happened in Kritias. He asked you to investigate Kritias again to shed light on the questions that still remain. You first met Head Maid Parma.

0.0: I see. The Black Mage never destroyed Kritias, but rather stuck it into subspace until he could complete his plan.
0.1: Something's not quite right... Why did it have to be that way? I don't know why the entire kingdom was made into a pentacle, hid in a spacetime crack, then made to reappear.
0.2: Furthermore, it's hard to get involved in the matter when the king of Kritias is also missing. They are figures from centuries ago. We don't know what the aftermath of the Alliance's intervention will be.
0.3: Please go to Kritias again and find out the truth. What happened in Kritias on the day the castle rose? Where is the king? And the Black Mage... What was he looking for in Kritias?

yes.0: According to the report, the royalty and servants managed to escape. This is a sensitive issue, but it will be most accurate to ask them about the king's whereabouts.
yes.1: Head Maid Parma should know something. I heard she's not that easy to work with, but you should start with her. \r\n#b(*Press Confirm to move instantly.)#k

no.0: There are too many things that are not quite right. What threat does all these pose...

1.0: Hm? Do you still have some business?
